1.text: Uwo munsi Yesu asohoka mu nzu, yicara mu kibaya cy'inyanja.

2.text: Abantu benshi bateranira aho ari, bituma yikira mu bwato yicaramo, abantu bose bahagarara mu kibaya.

3.text: Abigisha byinshi, abacira imigani aravuga ati“Umubibyi yasohoye imbuto.

4.text: Akibiba zimwe zigwa mu nzira, inyoni ziraza zirazitoragura.

5.text: Izindi zigwa ku kāra kadafite ubutaka bwinshi, uwo mwanya ziramera kuko ubutaka atari burebure,

6.text: izuba rivuye ziraraba, maze kuko zitari zifite imizi ziruma.

7.text: Izindi zigwa mu mahwa, amahwa arāruka araziniga.

8.text: Izindi zigwa mu butaka bwiza zera imbuto, imwe ijana, indi mirongo itandatu, indi mirongo itatu, bityo bityo.

10.text: Abigishwa baramwegera baramubaza bati “Ni iki gituma ubigishiriza mu migani?”

11.text: Arabasubiza ati “Mwebweho mwahawe kumenya ubwiru bw'ubwami bwo mu ijuru ariko bo ntibabihawe,

12.text: kuko ufite wese azahabwa kandi akarushirizwaho, ariko udafite wese azakwa n'icyo yari afite.

13.text: Igituma mbigishiriza mu migani ni iki: ‘Ni uko iyo barebye batitegereza, n'iyo bumvise batumva kandi ntibasobanukirwe.’

14.text: Ndetse ibyo Yesaya yahanuye bibasohoyeho ngo‘Kumva muzumva, ariko ntimuzabisobanukirwa,Kureba muzareba, ariko ntimuzabibona.

15.text: Kuko umutima w'ubu bwoko ufite ibinure,Amatwi yabo akaba ari ibihurihuri,Amaso yabo bakayahumiriza,Ngo batarebesha amaso,Batumvisha amatwi,Batamenyesha umutima,Bagahindukira ngo mbakize.’

16.text: “Ariko amaso yanyu arahirwa kuko abona, n'amatwi yanyu kuko yumva.

17.text: Ndababwira ukuri, yuko abahanuzi benshi n'abakiranutsi bifuzaga kureba ibyo mureba ntibabibone, no kumva ibyo mwumva ntibabyumve.

19.text: Uwumva wese ijambo ry'ubwami ntarimenye, Umubi araza agasahura ikibibwe mu mutima we. Uwo ni we usa n'izibibwe mu nzira.

20.text: Kandi usa n'izibibwe ku kāra, uwo ni we wumva ijambo, uwo mwanya akaryemera anezerewe,

21.text: ntagire imizi muri we, maze agakomera umwanya muto. Iyo habayeho amakuba cyangwa kurenganywa azira iryo jambo, uwo mwanya biramugusha.

22.text: Kandi usa n'izibibwe mu mahwa, uwo ni we wumva ijambo, maze amaganya y'iyi si n'ibihendo by'ubutunzi bikaniga iryo jambo ntiryere.

23.text: Kandi usa n'izibibwe mu butaka bwiza, uwo ni we wumva ijambo akarimenya, akera imbuto umwe ijana, undi mirongo itandatu, undi mirongo itatu.”

24.text: Nuko abacira undi mugani aravuga ati “Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bugereranywa n'umuntu wabibye imbuto nziza mu murima we,

25.text: nuko abantu basinziriye, umwanzi araza abiba urukungu mu masaka, aragenda.

26.text: Nuko amaze kumera no kwera, urukungu na rwo ruraboneka.

27.text: Abagaragu be baraza babaza umutware bati ‘Mutware, ntiwabibye imbuto nziza mu murima wawe? None urukungu rurimo rwavuye he?’

28.text: Ati ‘Umwanzi ni we wagize atyo.’ Abagaragu be baramubaza bati ‘Noneho urashaka ko tugenda tukarurandura?’

29.text: Na we ati ‘Oya, ahari nimurandura urukungu murarurandurana n'amasaka,

30.text: mureke bikurane byombi bigeze igihe cyo gusarurwa. Mu isarura nzabwira abasaruzi nti: Mubanze muteranye urukungu muruhambire imitwaro rutwikwe, maze amasaka muyahunike mu kigega cyanjye.’ ”

31.text: Abacira undi mugani ati “Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bugereranywa n'akabuto ka sinapi, umuntu yenze akakabiba mu murima we.

32.text: Na ko ni gato hanyuma y'imbuto zose, nyamara iyo gakuze kaba kanini kakaruta imboga zose kakaba igiti, maze inyoni zo mu kirere zikaza zikarika ibyari mu mashami yacyo.”

33.text: Abacira undi mugani ati “Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bugereranywa n'umusemburo umugore yenze, akawuhisha mu myariko itatu y'ifu kugeza aho iri busemburwe yose.”

34.text: Ayo magambo yose Yesu ayigisha abantu mu migani, kandi nta cyo yabigishaga atabaciriye umugani,

35.text: kugira ngo ibyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi bisohore ngo“Nzabumbura akanwa kanjye nce imigani,Nzavuga amagambo yahishwe uhereye ku kuremwa kw'isi.”

36.text: Maze asezera ku bantu yinjira mu nzu, abigishwa be baramwegera bati “Dusobanurire umugani w'urukungu rwo mu murima.”

37.text: Arabasubiza ati “Ubiba imbuto nziza ni Umwana w'umuntu,

38.text: umurima ni isi, imbuto nziza ni zo bana b'ubwami, urukungu ni abana b'Umubi,

39.text: umwanzi warubibye ni Umwanzi, isarura ni imperuka y'isi, abasaruzi ni abamarayika.

40.text: Nk'uko urukungu rurandurwa rugatwikwa, ni ko bizaba ku mperuka y'isi.

41.text: Umwana w'umuntu azatuma abamarayika be, bateranye ibintu bigusha byose n'inkozi z'ibibi babikure mu bwami bwe,

42.text: babajugunye mu itanura ry'umuriro. Ni ho bazaririra bakahahekenyera amenyo.

43.text: Icyo gihe abakiranutsi bazarabagirana nk'izuba mu bwami bwa Se. Ufite amatwi niyumve.

44.text: “Ubwami bwo mu ijuru bugereranywa n'izahabu zahishwe mu murima, umuntu azigwaho arazitwikīra aragenda, umunezero umutera kugura ibyo yari atunze byose ngo abone kugura uwo murima.

45.text: “Kandi ubwami bwo mu ijuru bugereranywa n'umutunzi ushaka imaragarita nziza,

46.text: abonye imaragarita imwe y'igiciro cyinshi, aragenda agura ibyo yari atunze byose ngo abone kuyigura.

47.text: “Nuko kandi ubwami bwo mu ijuru bugereranywa n'urushundura bajugunya mu nyanja, ruroba ifi z'amoko yose.

48.text: Iyo rwuzuye barukururira ku nkombe, bakicara bagatoranyamo inziza bakazishyira mu mbehe, imbi bakazita.

49.text: Uko ni ko bizaba ku mperuka y'isi: abamarayika bazasohoka batoranye abanyabyaha mu bakiranutsi,

50.text: babajugunye mu itanura ry'umuriro, ni ho bazaririra bakahahekenyera amenyo.

52.text: Arababwira ati “Ni cyo gitumye umwanditsi wese wigishijwe iby'ubwami bwo mu ijuru agereranywa na nyir'urugo utanga ibintu bishya n'ibya kera, abikuye mu bubiko bwe.”

53.text: Yesu amaze kubacira iyo migani, avayo

54.text: ajya mu gihugu cy'iwabo, aheraho yigishiriza mu masinagogi yabo, bituma batangara bati “Ubu bwenge n'ibi bitangaza uyu yabikuye he?

55.text: Mbese harya si we wa mwana w'umubaji? Nyina ntiyitwa Mariya, na bene se si Yakobo na Yosefu na Simoni na Yuda?

56.text: Bashiki be na bo bose ntiduturanye? Mbese ibyo byose yabikuye he?”

57.text: Ibye birabagusha.Yesu arababwira ati “Umuhanuzi ntabura icyubahiro, keretse mu gihugu cy'iwabo no mu nzu yabo.”

58.text: Aho Yesu ntiyakorerayo ibitangaza byinshi abitewe n'uko batamwizeye.
